keys.enValue: Course Schedule Sync failed. Please grant the App full access to calendars, or try restarting the App if you have already done so.

keys.name: loh_assignment_sync_description
keys.zhValue: 启用后，作业会在刷新时自动同步；已屏蔽课程的作业或已归档、已过期的作业不会被同步；请在更改设置后刷新作业以应用更改。
keys.enValue: If enabled, assignments will be synced automatically when refreshed. Assignments that are hidden, archived or have passed the due date will not be synced. Please refresh assignments after any setting change.

keys.name: loh_clear_file_cache_confirmation
keys.zhValue: 确定清空文件缓存？该操作不可撤销。

keys.enValue: Do you want to enable Course Information Sharing? Information of courses of the current semester will be uploaded. Personal information will never be uploaded or shared.

keys.zhValue: 课程信息共享计划 courseX

keys.name: loh_missing_calendar_source

keys.enValue: Missing calendar source. Make sure you have an iCloud enabled calendar category or at least one local calendar category set up in the Calendar app.

keys.name: loh_push_notification_token_description
keys.zhValue: 使用此标识符，配合 learnX Companion 应用，您可以在此设备上接收推送通知。请勿分享此标识符给其他人。
keys.enValue: Use this token with the learnX Companion app to receive push notifications on this device. Don't share it with others.

keys.name: loh_issue_template_description
keys.zhValue: 如通过邮件提交问题反馈或寻求帮助，请务必使用以下模板：
keys.enValue: If you are submitting an issue or asking for help via email, please use the following template:

keys.name: loh_issue_template_content
keys.zhValue:
- 问题描述
    - 复现步骤
    - 已尝试的解决方案
    - 截图
    - App 版本
    - 设备型号
    - 系统版本
    - 其他补充信息
keys.enValue:
- Issue Description
    - Reproduction Steps
    - Attempts to Fix
    - Screenshots
    - App Version
    - Device Model
    - OS Version
    - Other Information

keys.name: loh_sso
keys.zhValue: 清华大学用户电子身份服务系统
keys.enValue: Electronic ID Service System of Tsinghua University

keys.name: loh_sso_note
keys.zhValue:
请在即将打开的网页中完成登录。如需更改网页中预填的账号或密码，请关闭网页，再在 learnX 登录界面重新输入正确的账号及密码。

如果提示“信任浏览器数量已达到上限”，请在浏览器登录 https://id.tsinghua.edu.cn，前往账号设置-多因子认证-信任浏览器数量-维护，选择并删除其他设备。
keys.enValue:
Please complete the login on the webpage that will open. If you need to change the pre-filled username or password, please close the webpage and re-enter the correct username and password on the learnX login screen.

If seeing an error on trusted browser limit, please log in to https://id.tsinghua.edu.cn in your browser, go to Settings - Two-factor Authentication - Number of trusted device browsers - Manage, and delete other devices.

keys.name: loh_sso_failed
keys.enValue: Failed to complete the login process. Please try again.

keys.name: loh_avoid_front_camera_description
keys.zhValue: 在上部留出空间以避让挖孔区域，需要重启应用
keys.enValue: Leave top space to avoid the front camera cutout. App restart required.

keys.name: loh_please_restart_app_to_apply_immersive

keys.enValue: Please restart the app to apply immersive mode setting.

keys.enValue: The semester list is unavailable; only the current and the active semester are listed.

keys.name: ui_enrollment_fingerprint_not_ready
keys.zhValue: 浏览器指纹尚未就绪，此刻提交不会把该浏览器记为可信（服务端会提示"隐私或匿名模式"）。请稍等几秒后再次点击登录；若反复出现，请关闭本页重新登录。
keys.enValue: The browser fingerprint is not ready yet, so signing in now would not register this browser as trusted (the server would report a private/anonymous browser). Wait a few seconds and tap sign in again; if it keeps happening, close this page and sign in again.

keys.name: ui_file_use_document_dir_on
